findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] The verification this CM asks for is automated here. A PAYLOADS list covers seven injection strings (script tags, img and svg event handlers, a javascript: URL, an attribute break-out and unicode-escaped markup) and is parametrized across store and read paths to assert the values round-trip verbatim rather than being rendered. Response-level assertions confirm application/json content type and X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, which is what keeps the stored markup inert in a browser. Further tests assert the declared schema bounds, that an undeclared field is refused, that validation happens server-side for a payload no form would produce, and that a 422 does not echo the submitted value | verdict=pass confidence=high
